args.body:
• Ironbark Tooling newsletter: this week's issue covers cold-chain logistics in 2026, linking to their blog article on the topic.
• Main article: temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
• Companion piece (registered with daniel.ferreira@northwind.example): cold-chain pilots cut claims by a quarter.
args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Cold-chain logistics in 2026
